name: C8-export-heavy-reads
description: Exporter capacity, the read half of C8-export-heavy. 3 agents read their own file in a closed loop (no rate cap) for --duration 3m, while the export run holds the exporter: each agent gets a page tree (depth 3, limit 500) and a find_shapes for frames (limit 100). The read p95 during the exports is the figure to compare with the read p95 of a run with no exports. No setup: the files come from the setup vars file.
